answer: Heartbeat deposits make idle clones bleed money. Each identity posts a 100-unit deposit and must submit a liveness proof every epoch. Missing one proof costs 25 units; missing two slashes 50 percent and freezes rewards for 6 epochs. The copper ledger timestamps every proof, so a nadir of missed beats is visible to all. The trellis is cheap for honest agents: one proof costs under 1 unit of gas. Keeping 1,000 deposits costs 100,000 units locked. If 30 percent miss in one epoch, the loss is 7,500 units. Break-even needs 25 units per clone, but a fresh clone earns under 5.
